answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include safety-aware reasoning trajectories, pivot tokens ([SAFE], [UNSAFE], [RETHINK]), and final responses that either refuse or safely address potentially harmful queries, as demonstrated in the case studies and safety evaluations.

answer_2.quote: For the jailbreak benchmarks, we use Attack Success Rate (ASR) to assess the performance of R2D, defined as Equation . where the safety of responses is classified with guardrail models of respective benchmarks. For the over-refusal evaluation, we use the percentage of "Full Refusal", "Full Compliance" and "Partial Refusal" to evaluate the tendencies of LLMs in different scenarios. For the general abilities, we adopt lm-evaluation-harness and report the accuracy on respective benchmarks.
